description: This file contains unit tests for the settings validation logic of a Django-based e-commerce application. It verifies environment-specific configurations such as secret key presence, allowed hosts restrictions, and payment mode requirements.

methods.name: test_validate_settings_debug_gating(monkeypatch, debug, environment, should_raise)
methods.description: Tests that the validation correctly raises errors or passes based on debug mode and environment.

methods.name: test_validate_settings_requires_secret_key_in_production(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Ensures that an ImproperlyConfigured error is raised if SECRET_KEY is missing in production environment.

methods.name: test_validate_settings_disallows_wildcard_allowed_hosts_in_production(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Checks that wildcard allowed hosts ('*') are not permitted in production environments.

methods.name: test_validate_settings_requires_stripe_keys_when_stripe_mode_in_production( monkeypatch, )
methods.description: Verifies that Stripe keys are required when payment mode is set to Stripe in a production environment.
